I am also facing the same issue with Streamlit 1.37.0
I haven't faced this kind of issue in past versions of Steamlit. Please help me as it is giving issues in production as well.

Hi there,
I was facing this problem in version **1.37.1**.

I tried to **reproduce** it in a simple scenario (not the same complex scenario as I am developing in the company, because of legal issues) that I could share here, but it seems to occur only in more complex scenarios.

My scenarios were the following:

1) I had an one page app with a **st.sidebar.selectbox** where one of five options available is selected, then it changes the app main content using if/else statements. In this scenario the problem **didn't happened**;

2) I refactored it to a more modularized and organized app, inserted an **asynchronous** request for an online Excel spreadsheet and loaded it in an **st.dataframe** inside an **st.tabs**. Here the **problem happens**. 

I was wondering if the problem is related to the st.tabs component working together async functions, but I perceived that the problem happens just in one situation: when I change the first loaded page (selecting an option on the st.sidebar.selectbox) to the page where the tabs+dataframe are placed. When I first change to other pages and then to the tabs+dataframe page, the problem doesn`t happens. Nothing seems to explain this behavior.

Workaround solution:

I **solved** my problem when I changed my app **navigation patterns**, using the **st.Page** and **st.navigation** components. They seem better encapsulate the pages and prevent interferences among them. You all could try it while we cannot reproduce the problem to proceed with a definitive solution. I hope I've helped. Let me know if it worked for you too.

### Checklist

- [X] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [X] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [X] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

In the latest version of Streamlit (1.37.0), st.tabs loads blank page. The nature of this error is transient. I am not sure what is going on but when it loads a blank page. I give the errors in the browser's console. Sometimes the same code works fine but sometimes it loads a blank page.

### Reproducible Code Example

```Python
# loading some data in session

tab1, tab2, tab3 = st.tabs(["1", "2", "3"])
    with tab1:
        st.info('Some info in tab1.')
    with tab2:
        st.info('Some info in tab2.')
    with tab3:
        st.info('Some info in tab3.')
```


### Steps To Reproduce

_No response_

### Expected Behavior

It should load the tabs I have defined with the design for each tab.

### Current Behavior

It loads the data but when try to execute st.tabs snippet, it gives an error in the browser's console. I have attached a screenshot

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/61ea05f6-2785-414e-affe-67767537d2a9)


### Is this a regression?

- [X] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

- Streamlit version: 1.37.0
- Python version: 3.10.12
- Operating System: Ubuntu 22.04 
- Browser: Firefox and Chrome

issue.body:
## Describe your changes

We have this convenience that preserves the children of a block even if a block changes. This was likely because we want to keep the same block and children and we don't want to make random elements disappear (and preserve widget state). This change keeps the existing behavior, but it _will_ reset the children if the _type_ of the block changes as well. 

## GitHub Issue Link (if applicable)
Closes #9259
Closes #8676

## Testing Plan

- Added a unit test to define the behavior accurately
